title: LoadCancelled
description: An open load left the market: its shipper or an operator withdrew it, or its haul was cancelled and it was not posted again.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

fee_booking_id.description: Set when the load closed because its shipper cancelled this haul late: a card payment of the load is then settled by that haul's fee, not released.
